Plain JSON: json.load reads the whole file in one call, not JSONL. This file has room to grow: a later field (brand, size, unit, image URL, category) is added as a new key on new entries, never by changing this shape, and load_product_names in scripts/build_app_db.py ignores any key besides barcode/name, so old entries and old readers both keep working. Teaching the build to use a new field is a separate change to that function, not to this file.
